svg.title: The forest 106 walks on GF(2^131) build on their way to distinguished points
svg.desc: 1817 orbits drawn, one every 2048 iterations, over 3400768 iterations in all; 106 distinguished points, 0 meetings between walks from different starts. Drawn as a circle: each distinguished point on the rim, each walk coming in to it from as far inside as it had iterations to go, up to 65536 at the hub. Generated by scripts/site/walk_forest.py from trails written by ecc2k130/src/trailforest.cpp. # curve 131 instance -1 dp-weight 34 mode sample source corpus every 2048 cap 65536 tried 256 drawn 106 checked 106 hash sha256-16
